$description: External citation ledger. 'ref' is relative to design-repo/ (e.g. ../CLONE_SPEC.md:120-140). verify_all.py resolves each ref when the source project sits beside the repo (or --source-root is given): file exists, range within file length, anchor inside the range. When the source is absent (standalone copy, zip) it WARNS, never fails. 'volatile' marks src/ citations re-located by anchor because another agent edits src/ concurrently.

evidenceConflicts.finding: MOTION_TIMINGS.md describes one 320ms ease-out wrapper fade; CLONE_SPEC.md 3b measures fade-out .24s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1) and fade-in .32s ease-out.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: CLONE_SPEC.md wins (live-measured; MOTION_TIMINGS.md itself defers to it; src/index.css and the later audits agree).

evidenceConflicts.finding: CLONE_SPEC.md 3b (and MOTION_TIMINGS.md) say reduced motion freezes on the still frame 16000/12000/17000; a later audit found the live original freezes on a near-empty first frame.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: The clone keeps the finished still frame on purpose. Recorded as a deliberate deviation in motion.reducedMotion.demos and every demo variant's reducedMotionFallback.

evidenceConflicts.finding: An earlier CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md draft said no Changelog link exists in the footer; the current text (re-verified live 2026-10-21) says home has 5 Product links incl. Changelog, sub-pages 4.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: v1.1.0: two footer variants. brand-two-groups (home) has exactly 5 Product links and must include /changelog; brand-two-groups-subpage (about, pricing, changelog, docs) has exactly 4 and must not. Footer.jsx shows Changelog only with showChangelog (home). Enforced by the schema counts and rule FOOTER_PRODUCT_LINKS.

evidenceConflicts.finding: CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md 0 says the current page link gets [data-pill-active] ('On /about, About is active'); the motion audit (section 10) measured the resting pill on 'Sign up' on every page, with the current link kept bright by aria-current.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: Section 10 wins (later, live-measured; Navbar.jsx now rests on Sign up). shell.nav[on-hero-current] keeps currentHref -> aria-current + bright, and no longer claims the current link is the resting pill.

evidenceConflicts.finding: Section 0 says /pricing uses the default timings for the first 3 lines but was not separately logged; section 10 times it live as L1 600ms, L2 +917ms/700ms, L3 +1900ms/800ms, done +2700ms, which looks different from the 700/760/880 durations.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: No real conflict: measured from the first char, the default slots start at +0/+920/+1900 and an n-char line shows its last char at (n-1)/n of its duration (8ch: 612, 14ch: 706, 11ch: 800ms), giving done at +2700. The defaults stand; hero.typewriter-intro[pricing] records the live corroboration.

evidenceConflicts.finding: CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md 1 prose says /about at 390 has main padding 72px 0 56px; the same paragraph's measurements (main y84, h1 y148) imply 64px, and the later audit confirmed 64 against live.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: 64px (measurement + audit beat prose). About.jsx uses lt600:pt-16; hero.typewriter-intro[about] responsive and spacing.aboutHeroPadTopMobile say 64. /pricing keeps 72 (measured y84 -> h1 y156).

evidenceConflicts.finding: CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md 1 says --lift/--grow/--tilt are plain custom properties and are not interpolated; src/index.css now registers them with @property because a later live measurement (--grow 1.051 / --lift -11.9px at 17ms) showed live interpolates them.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: The later live measurement wins: motion.photo.toss lists the registered properties. Durations and easing (.35s / .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)) agree in both sources.

evidenceConflicts.finding: Clerk's SSR appearance config asks for a card (radius 24, padding 32, shadow); the rendered DOM applies none of it.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: Build to the rendered values (the spec says so): auth.form-mock has no card chrome. The intended config is not tokenised.

evidenceConflicts.finding: CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md 0 is headed 'Page shells (three variants)' but the routes use five shells (three landing shells plus the app shell D and the auth shell E).
evidenceConflicts.resolution: Five shells; templates were split by the composition classifier (7 page shapes for 9 routes), not by shell count.

evidenceConflicts.finding: The spec lists the /sign-up subtitle without a final period; AuthMock.jsx renders it with one. The pixel-audit DOM dump truncates the string, so it cannot settle it.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: Unresolved and immaterial here: the repo stores no auth strings (examples use original copy); the subtitle budget (9 words / 51 chars) fits either form.

evidenceConflicts.finding: Live shows 'Secured by' plus a 48x14 vendor wordmark SVG; the clone renders the vendor name as text.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: Neither is generated: auth.form-mock excludes the vendor credit row because a static mock has no provider.

evidenceConflicts.finding: CLONE_SPEC.md 10 says only nav hover was mouse-tested; other hover values came from CSS rules.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: The later audit verified the chip, pause-button and footer-link hovers with a real mouse; values unchanged.

evidenceConflicts.finding: CLONE_SPEC.md mentions 'max-width:540/480px: minor'; no 540 rule exists in src/ and no 540 behaviour is described.
evidenceConflicts.resolution: 540 is left out (ungrounded). 800 is kept as a minor breakpoint (tailwind lt800, one font-size change).
